segments.speaker: F. Khalid
segments.text: Good morning everyone, let us start with the notetaker pilot.

segments.speaker: R. Haddad
segments.text: The prototype transcribes English and Arabic locally; nothing leaves the bank's devices.

segments.speaker: L. Farouk
segments.text: I propose we start with volunteers from the data team only.

segments.speaker: F. Khalid
segments.text: Agreed. The pilot starts on the first of October, limited to volunteers from the data team.

segments.speaker: Omar Nasser
segments.text: I will draft the privacy notice and the consent script by Thursday and share it with Legal.

segments.speaker: S. Al-Mahmood
segments.text: One risk: transcripts may include customer names, so we redact before the model sees them.

segments.speaker: L. Farouk
segments.text: Open question: do we keep raw audio at all after the minutes are approved?

segments.speaker: R. Haddad
segments.text: The GPU business case goes to ManCom on the twenty-second of October; I will present it.

segments.speaker: F. Khalid
segments.text: The budget line is BHD 250,000 for the first phase.

segments.speaker: F. Khalid
segments.text: Let us not decide the retention question today; we take it offline.

segments.speaker: T. Brennan
segments.text: Maybe you could also try our hosted transcription service for comparison.

segments.speaker: F. Khalid
segments.text: No, nothing goes to the cloud. To summarise: pilot approved from the first of October, notice by Thursday.
